gaps.lead: 'I'll call you as soon as I land,' she said.
gaps.sentence: She promised ___ as soon as she landed.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call (me); pronouns shift.

gaps.lead: 'Can you open the door for me?' she asked me.
gaps.sentence: She asked ___ the door for her.
gaps.explanation: ask somebody TO do something: asked me to open.

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: I'm afraid this is the last tin of paint we have.
gaps.hint: run out of = have none left
gaps.explanation: run out of = have no more of something left.

gaps.lead: He lost his job because he kept arriving late.
gaps.sentence: If he hadn't kept arriving late, he ___ his job.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + participle.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.
